title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30-45k BRL


Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.


Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.


Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  1. Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  2. Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  3. System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  4. Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  5. Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  6. Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.


Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando - Grupo Boticário - Projeto Turing

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.


O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.


Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:


No Grupo Boticário, a busca por inovação sustentável e ciência aplicada à beleza se reflete em iniciativas que unem tecnologia, biologia e propósito. Nesse contexto, o projeto propõe o desenvolvimento e validação de uma plataforma integrada de modelagem preditiva , baseada em inteligência artificial , voltada à avaliação da segurança e eficácia de matérias-primas cosméticas naturais .



Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado completo Química, Farmácia, Bioinformática, Biotecnologia, Ciências Biológicas, Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Idioma: Inglês Avançado (leitura e escrita)


Projeto: Projeto Turing


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e validar experimentalmente uma plataforma, utilizando inteligência artificial, para avaliação de matérias-primas cosméticas.


Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • QSAR (Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship);
  • Machine learning;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos;
  • Análise de dados;
  • RDKit;
  • Noções de bioinformática;


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de técnicas in vitro, biologia celular e molecular será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência anterior laboratorial e também com analise de dados.


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido (2 a 3x por semana presencial)

  • Certificação GMP+

  • Conhecimento e experiência com certificações como FSSC 22000, Kosher e Halal;

  • Conhecimento das legislações vigentes da área;
  • Experiência prévia em indústria.


Localidade:

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil
description:
A função

A Kaleido está em busca de um Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil para nos representar como a face técnica do nosso negócio no país. Nesta posição sênior, você será responsável por conduzir ciclos complexos de pré-vendas, fortalecer o ecossistema de parceiros, impulsionar uma comunidade técnica vibrante e supervisionar as primeiras implementações de clientes. Você garantirá que os PoCs e as entregas iniciais em Kaleido/FireFly estabeleçam o padrão em segurança, conformidade e escala.


Sobre nós

A Kaleido oferece uma plataforma de próxima geração para construção e conexão com redes descentralizadas (ex.: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Canton) em nuvem e Kubernetes. Combinamos tecnologias open source e proprietárias para fornecer middleware, gestão de ativos digitais e soluções de custódia. Nossa plataforma permite que clientes criem casos de uso corporativos integrados a ecossistemas descentralizados e ativos digitais — seja em nosso SaaS ou em nuvens privadas.


Responsabilidades

Arquitetura de Soluções em Pré-Vendas

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery, delimitar escopos de soluções, realizar demonstrações, desenvolver PoCs e analisar RFPs; produzir propostas técnicas, estimativas e arquiteturas prontas para SOW.
  • Mapear requisitos regulatórios e de conformidade no Brasil (ex.: CVM 175, LGPD, controles do setor financeiro) para desenhos técnicos, boas práticas de segurança e runbooks.
  • Mitigar riscos em negociações com arquiteturas de referência, planos de migração e critérios de sucesso; acelerar a transição de PoC para produção.

Ecossistema de Parceiros e Alianças

  • Identificar, recrutar, integrar e capacitar parceiros.
  • Desenvolver programas de capacitação: currículo, laboratórios práticos, trilhas de certificação, ativos reutilizáveis (implementações de referência, blueprints Terraform/K8s, templates de contratos).
  • Conduzir iniciativas de co-sell e co-delivery com estratégias de GTM conjuntas e governança clara.

Comunidade Técnica e Evangelismo

  • Representar a Kaleido em meetups, conferências e universidades; liderar workshops, bootcamps e hackathons.
  • Publicar conteúdo técnico (blogs, tutoriais, apps de exemplo, arquiteturas de referência) e manter repositórios OSS demonstrando boas práticas de FireFly/EVM.
  • Formar uma rede de contribuidores e cultivar champions e maintainers locais.

Arquitetura e Acompanhamento das Primeiras Entregas

  • Orientar implementações referência em Kaleido/FireFly (EVM/Besu/Quorum), padrões de privacidade, troca de dados e integrações com sistemas bancários (APIs, eventos, ISO 20022).
  • Definir SLOs/SLIs, IaC (Terraform/Kubernetes), CI/CD, observabilidade e assegurar a transição suave para os times de entrega e sucesso do cliente.

Segurança e Padrões de Custódia

  • Projetar integrações seguras de gestão de chaves e custódia (HSM/KMS, MPC, cofres).
  • Aplicar modelagem de ameaças, auditoria e controles de privacidade em casos de uso regulados.

Feedback de Produto

  • Canalizar insights de mercado e parceiros para o roadmap global, defendendo padrões específicos do Brasil.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação/Engenharia (ou experiência equivalente).
  • 6+ anos em engenharia de software; 3+ anos em pré-vendas/soluções com clientes; 3+ anos em blockchain corporativo.
  • Experiência prática com EVM (Solidity, upgradeability, Hardhat/Foundry) e Kaleido/FireFly (ou frameworks similares de private-tx/data-exchange).
  • Conhecimento em padrões de integração com REST/gRPC, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, mensageria e ISO 20022; familiaridade com fluxos de liquidação (PIX/SPI/STR, DvP).
  • Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), AWS e/ou Azure.
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders (executivos, vendas, produto, reguladores).
  • Fluência em português e inglês avançado; espanhol é um diferencial.


Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência no desenho de programas de capacitação de parceiros (trilhas de certificação, conteúdos, soluções conjuntas).
  • Conhecimento em Hyperledger Fabric e/ou R3 Corda.
  • Certificações de segurança ou nuvem (CISSP/CCSK, AWS/Azure, CKA/CKAD).
  • Experiência em palestras, publicação de conteúdo técnico ou contribuições ativas em OSS.


Diversidade e Inclusão

A Kaleido é comprometida em promover um ambiente inclusivo que celebre a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Valorizamos indivíduos de diferentes origens, culturas e experiências, e buscamos criar um espaço onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e apoiados. A Kaleido é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas qualificadas de todos os perfis a se candidatarem.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:


Talent Development & Retention

  • Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.
  • Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.
  • Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.
  • Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, EdCamps).


Attracting & Retaining Talent

  • Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.
  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.
  • Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.
  • Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.
  • Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.
  • Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.
  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.


Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture

  • Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.
  • Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.
  • Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.
  • Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.


Compliance and Child Protection

  • Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.
  • Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws
  • Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).
  • Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.
  • Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.
  • Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.


Wellbeing

  • Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.
  • Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.
  • Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.


Health (physical and mental/emotional)

  • Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.
  • Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.
  • Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.
  • Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.


Other duties, as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS


  • BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience
  • HR policies, procedures, and best practices
  • Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)
  • HR Information Systems (HRIS)
  • Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle
  • Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking
  • Professional development and training frameworks
  • Child protection and safeguarding protocols
  • Cultural competence and sensitivity.
  • Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese


Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Excellent communication (verbal and written)
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • High attention to detail
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution
  • Interpersonal skills and empathy
  • Confidentiality and discretion
  • Data analysis
  • Adaptability and proactivity
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity
  • Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.


Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.


EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.


Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:


Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.


Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.


Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 


Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.


Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.


Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials


Other duties, as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS:


  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above


Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills


Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.


EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Van Hessen is one of the leading global players in the sourcing, processing and distribution of natural casings, meat products and pharmaceuticals. We process animal by-products from slaughterhouses into high-quality food materials and raw materials for the pharmaceutical industry. Our products are 100% natural and, due to the knowledge and skills of our employees, of a very high and consistent quality. We strive to outdo ourselves every day.


About the role

Manage and coordinate the company's human resources function across subfunctions, such as recruitment, training and talent development, compensation and benefits, organization development, and employee relations, to meet company’s business requirements.


Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the formation of one or more elements of functional strategy through specialist expertise and insights, to ensure that the strategy meets business needs.
  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
  • Deliver complex analyses of HR data; identify key trends and contribute to the creation of HR insights that enable the diagnosis of business issues, enhancement of employee engagement, and/or improvement of business performance.
  • Implement HR frameworks and tools for recruitment, performance management, development, career and succession planning, compensation and benefits, diversity, employee onboarding and offboarding, and retention of talent, within an area of expertise, to meet business or institution needs and enable the attraction, development, and retention of talent at a sustainable cost. Ensure compliance with specified design principles, internal policies, and external legal requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice on the interpretation and application of policies and procedures, resolving queries and issues and referring very complex or contentious issues to others.
  • Communicate the local action plan; explain how this relates to the function's strategy and action plan and to the broader organization's mission and vision; motivate people to achieve local business goals.
  • Help develop procedures for an area of the organization and monitor their implementation.
  • Deliver a budget for an area of the organization or conduct complex analyses on budget progress in other areas of the organization.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of HR data collection forms or questionnaires in a specific area of expertise to ensure the collection of relevant data in line with defined requirements.
  • Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.

title: Analista de Engenharia Pleno - Segurança Hídrica
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na análise e desenvolvimento de estudos hidrológicos voltados à mitigação dos impactos de estiagens e secas;
  • Realizar o levantamento e monitoramento de indicadores de vazão, precipitação, volume de chuvas e comportamento de rios e barragens;
  • Avaliar e propor fontes alternativas de abastecimento, contribuindo para a elaboração de soluções técnicas e planos de investimento de capital (CAPEX);
  • Monitorar eventos climáticos e hidrológicos, analisando seus impactos sobre as operações da companhia e apoiando a tomada de decisão técnica;
  • Integrar e consolidar informações provenientes de dados de sensoriamento remoto, estudos climáticos, bases meteorológicas e análises de mercado especializadas, como as do Climatempo;
  • Manter comunicação ativa e constante com as frentes operacionais e áreas técnicas, garantindo agilidade e precisão nas ações preventivas e corretivas;
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico voltado à segurança hídrica, considerando cenários de estiagem, baixa vazão de rios e mudanças climáticas;
  • Garantir o registro e atualização de dados técnicos, assegurando rastreabilidade e consistência das informações analisadas.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Ambiental, Sanitária, Hídrica, Civil;
  • Experiência ou estudos na área de recursos hídricos, hidrologia e segurança hídrica;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de geoprocessamento, incluindo ArcGIS e QGIS;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e tratamento de dados, como Microsoft Excel e Power BI;

Ensino médio completo;

Cursando técnico/superior será um diferencial;

Conhecimento em SAP, Solinftec, Gatec, PowerApps, Logtrac, Power BI, Argus, GMC, Webtrack e Sistema de Gestão;

Disponibilidade para turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Compliance Officer - Brazil(A08354)
description:
【About PayerMax】

PayerMax is a global payment company focused on emerging markets , headquartered in Singapore.Through a unified platform, the company provides merchants with comprehensive payment solutions covering 70+ countries and 350+ local payment methods , supporting acquiring, payout, FX, and risk management needs across industries such as e-commerce, digital content, gaming, and financial services.

Our vision is to become the payment infrastructure for emerging markets , addressing pain points such as fragmented channels, high integration costs, and complex compliance requirements

  • Localization: Deep cooperation with major banks, wallets, and regulators to rapidly meet compliance and settlement requirements
  • Payment stability: Ensuring transaction success and user experience even under weak network conditions.
  • End-to-end services: Covering the full chain from user payments and merchant settlement to fund security, reconciliation, and risk control.
  • Long-term orientation: Emphasizing long-term partnerships and deep integration into local ecosystems rather than short-term gains.

PayerMax has successfully built payment networks across MENA, Southeast Asia, and Latin America ,serving global merchants such as TikTok, Tencent, Kuaishou, and Alibaba International, helping them improve local conversion rates and reduce compliance risks.


【Key Responsibilities】

1. Ensure compliance with local regulations, including Brazilian Central Bank rules.

2. Develop and maintain local policies and procedures to comply with local AML, KYC and channels requirements.

3. Ongoing monitoring of transactions and client behavior to detect and report suspicious activities.

4. Oversee merchants onboarding processes and industries to ensure compliance with the local regulations and have proper risk assessment.

5. Review local licensing frameworks and triggers. Be the key point of contact with legal and law firm for licensing preparation when company decides to apply for the license.

6. Implement a compliance training program for employees working with the LatAm region to promote a culture of ethics and local regulation awareness.

7. Ensure data privacy and security standards are followed in line with the Brazilian LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados).

8. Have ownership of data verification processes and compliance vendors relationship and payment application.

9. Assess regulatory risks in new products or services, including partnerships with banks, acquirers, and card schemes.

10. Update the company’s compliance framework in response to changes in local regulations


【Who we are looking for】

  • Minimum 5 years of solid experience in a compliance and AML related discipline preferably with a fintech or payment company.
  • Good understanding and knowledge of the Fintech/E-wallets/Online Payment, with relevant AML Compliance Advisory experience.

title: Sr. Strategy Research Manager
description:
About Keeta


Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!



Know more: Keeta Website


About the Job


Senior Strategy Research Associate


Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP


Job Responsibilities：


1. Study the business segments, geographical layout, financial strength, and strategic play of the world's leading food delivery players, form a clear judgment on the global food delivery industry landscape and competitive situation, and propose effective development strategies and competitive strategies based on this judgment to support Keeta management's major decisions on resource allocation, organizational structure, capital operation, etc.


2. Participate in desk research, field research, and strategy formulation for Keeta's expansion into new countries, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation path of the company's strategic expansion into new regions, and combine facts and analysis to provide objective judgments on the industry, competition, and operational difficulties in specific countries to assist Keeta management in making decisions;


3. Understand the catering and food delivery industries, gain insight into the laws of industry development, keep close track of new opportunities and new models in related areas such as instant retail and catering SaaS, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation paths of new strategic directions to assist Keeta management in making decisions and assist in business implementation. Job Responsibilities:


4. Analyze the restaurant and food delivery industries, identify industry trends, and monitor emerging opportunities in related sectors such as quick commerce and restaurant SaaS. Explore and evaluate the feasibility of new strategic directions to support management in decision-making and business implementation.


Job Requirements：

  • Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in business-related majors such as business administration, finance, accounting, and economics;
  • At least three years of relevant experience in internet strategy analysis, strategic consulting, investment, and investment banking, with research experience in the catering, retail, and food delivery industries preferred;
  • Possess a keen business acumen, structured thinking skills, excellent oral and written communication skills, self-motivation and independent thinking, strong data analysis skills, and extensive project management and teamwork experience;
  • Working level English proficiency (C2).


Highlights：


- Contribute to the foundational growth of the Brazil business from inception.

- Join a core team within a key business unit, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery industry and enhancing commercial analysis capabilities.

- Work closely with senior decision-makers as part of a high-performing team.

title: Sr Functional Analyst Manufacturing (São José dos Campos/SP)
description:

Responsible for leading efforts to analyze and define detailed specifications for business systems which map to business processes. Ensures solutions are in alignment with the enterprise architecture blueprint, the solutions architecture and ensures that systems and application designs adhere to standards and policies. Responsible for team guidance and delivery of complex, technical solutions to business needs.



Essential Responsible Areas:



  • Leads efforts to elicit future systems requirements using interviews, document analysis, requirements workshops, surveys, site visits, business process descriptions, use cases, scenarios, business analysis, task and workflow analysis to analyze, design and implement business solutions for complex business problems.
  • Partner with business analysts and respective cross-functional business groups (e.g. engineering, maintenance, IT, etc) to elicit functional and non-functional requirements
  • Proactively communicates and collaborates with external and internal customers to analyze information needs and functional requirements and deliver the following artifacts as needed: functional requirements, use cases, GUI, screen and interface designs).
  • Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative business solutions that challenges the business on their assumptions of how they will successfully execute their plans.
  • Participate in defining the integration between proposed development projects and existing systems, software and hardware.
  • Ensures that systems and application designs adhere to standards and reflect the architecture appropriately.
  • Collaborates with other divisions IT leads as well as other stakeholders to align solution in support of the business’ tactical and strategic plans. Aligns IT goals with business needs.
  • Researches emerging technologies and recommend technologies that will increase cost effectiveness, improve flexibility or better support business requirements.
  • Work closely with third-party vendors including software providers, implementation partners, and consultants
  • Understand existing and anticipated application functionality, including cloud-based offerings, that meet business demand.
  • Assist the team with user acceptance testing requirements for existing and new application systems and modules
  • Partner with key strategic solutions partners for small and large scale engagements to help develop the vision of the technology service
  • Manage the configuration, setup, and maintenance of application-related solutions
  • Mentors other analysts on the team by providing guidance and hands-on solving of complex problems.



Position Requirement & competencies:



Mandatory



  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (Engineering, Computer science)
  • Experience implementing solutions for complex systems supporting business processes.
  • Experience in driving software and technology solutions in large, complex organizations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and projects to drive business improvements
  • Experience in driving process and technology re-engineering using industry practices e.g., Six Sigma, Lean, Kaizen, COBIT, ITIL, CMMi
  • Business process knowledge (e.g., Plan-to-Produce process, manufacturing execution systems)
  • Manufacturing system knowledge (Maintenance, Quality, SAP Pm, SAP PP, Production, Process, SCADA, OPC)
  • Advanced English (spoken and written)



Essential Competencies:



  • Ability to be flexible about project changes and dynamically mitigate risks in the moment with mid-course corrective action
  • Strong analytical and product management skills required, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into application and operational requirements*
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to manage customer expectations regarding scope, schedule and budget.
  • Proven project planning and execution skills.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret data and make recommendations.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to learn new things



ADDITIONAL INFORMATION



  • Location: São José dos Campos/SP (GBS)

  • Schedule: 8:00 AM to 17:00 PM

title: Analista de Facilities Sr
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição será alocada em empresa multinacional do segmento de Óleo e Gás , referência global em soluções tecnológicas e excelência operacional.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar na governança da área, garantindo conformidade com políticas internas, requisitos contratuais e legais;
  • Gerir contratos de serviços multidisciplinares (hard e soft), assegurando cumprimento contratual, SLAs e KPIs;
  • Controlar o budget da carteira de atendimento, identificando oportunidades de saving e cost avoidance;
  • Monitorar o consumo de utilities e propor melhorias de eficiência;
  • Revisar e atualizar procedimentos estratégicos conforme demandas e requisitos da área;
  • Analisar medições de terceiros e atuar junto ao financeiro para manter o target orçamentário;
  • Consolidar e apresentar indicadores e resultados mensais (MOR) à liderança e ao cliente;
  • Atuar como ponto focal da área em auditorias internas e externas;
  • Liderar equipe multidisciplinar (Facilities, Financeiro e HSE), realizando controle de ponto, férias e PDI;
  • Acompanhar obras, projetos de retrofit e mudanças de layout, assegurando cumprimento de prazos e orçamentos;
  • Interpretar MDO para fundamentar negociações técnicas e financeiras com fornecedores;
  • Controlar o vencimento de documentos legais e patronais da equipe própria e de terceiros, garantindo conformidade legal e contratual através do sistema SG3.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação superior completa em Arquitetura, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de Facilities (hard e soft services);
  • Vivência em gestão de obras e capacidade de interpretar MDO;
  • Conhecimento em gestão orçamentária , elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho;
  • Habilidade de relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e equipes multidisciplinares ;
  • Desejável conhecimento em normas ISO 14001, ISO 50001, LEED ou programas ESG/compliance ;
  • Pacote Office avançado , especialmente Excel e PowerPoint.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para liderança de equipes diversas;
  • Perfil analítico e foco em resultados;
  • Capacidade de organização e priorização de demandas;
  • Proatividade na busca por soluções e melhoria contínua.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Atrair, identificar e selecionar os melhores talentos para atender às demandas operacionais e estratégicas da Diretoria de Logística, atuando de forma alinhada às políticas de Recursos Humanos e às diretrizes organizacionais, garantindo a eficiência dos processos seletivos e contribuindo para a formação de equipes qualificadas e alinhadas à cultura da empresa.

title: Assistente Administrativo Sênior
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

  • Elaborar atas de reuniões sempre que necessário.
  • Apoiar o envio de informações solicitadas pelos supervisores às áreas de apoio.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência profissional em rotinas administrativas.
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Formação técnica ou superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Habilidade na elaboração de apresentações e relatórios gerenciais.
  • CNH categoria B definitiva (desejável).

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Programador web
description:

Como Pessoa Programadora Web em nossa empresa, você será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções web de alta qualidade e performance, com foco especial na plataforma WordPress. Você atuará na linha de frente da criação e manutenção do nosso site institucional e portal de notícias, transformando necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades robustas. Sua expertise será crucial para gerenciar nosso fluxo de conteúdo digital e implementar soluções de publicidade, garantindo uma plataforma escalável, atualizada e eficiente.

Como Você Terá Sucesso Neste Cargo

Você terá sucesso ao:

  • Dominar o WordPress: Customizar temas, desenvolver plugins personalizados e gerenciar a arquitetura completa do WordPress para atender às necessidades específicas do negócio.
  • Otimizar a Gestão de Conteúdo: Implementar e manter um fluxo eficiente de publicação de notícias e materiais editoriais, garantindo interface intuitiva para a equipe de conteúdo.
  • Implementar Soluções de Publicidade: Integrar e gerenciar sistemas de anúncios e monetização, assegurando a correta veiculação e acompanhamento de campanhas publicitárias.
  • Ser Colaborativa e Comunicativa: Trabalhar de forma integrada com outras pessoas desenvolvedoras, designers, equipe de conteúdo e marketing, comunicando-se com clareza sobre prazos e requisitos técnicos.
  • Manter-se Constantemente Atualizada: Mostrar curiosidade e proatividade para aprender novas tecnologias e melhores práticas, trazendo inovação contínua para nossos projetos.

Como Este Cargo se Encaixa na Organização

Nossa equipe de tecnologia é o coração que impulsiona a inovação na empresa. Como Pessoa Programadora Web especializada em WordPress, você será fundamental para nossa estratégia de comunicação digital e presença online. Seu trabalho irá sustentar diretamente nossos canais de notícias e iniciativas de marketing, impactando milhares de usuários diariamente e contribuindo para os objetivos de negócio através da publicidade digital. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo onde cada contribuição é valorizada e onde você terá a oportunidade de crescer profissionalmente junto conosco.

Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter sites em WordPress, incluindo customização de temas e desenvolvimento de plugins personalizados.
  • Gerenciar a estrutura e o fluxo de publicação de notícias, criando e otimizando taxonomias, campos personalizados e tipos de conteúdo.
  • Implementar e integrar soluções de publicidade no site, incluindo gestão de espaços publicitários, inserção de códigos de terceiros e configuração de ads.txt.
  • Garantir a performance, segurança e SEO dos sites em WordPress, realizando otimizações técnicas regulares.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing e conteúdo para implementar novas funcionalidades e layouts para notícias e seções especiais.
  • Realizar a manutenção e atualização de plugins e do core do WordPress, garantindo a estabilidade do ambiente.
  • Desenvolver e manter a integração do WordPress com outros sistemas da empresa através de APIs REST.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica sobre a estrutura e funcionamento do site.
Qualificações

Competências e Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento WordPress, incluindo criação de temas e plugins personalizados.
  • Domínio de HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript e PHP.
  • Experiência com gestão de conteúdo em WordPress, incluindo Custom Post Types, Taxonomias e Campos Personalizados (ACF ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em implementação e gestão de publicidade digital (ex: Google Ad Manager, ads.txt, header bidding).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão, como Git.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, com metodologias como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Forte habilidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de colaborar efetivamente em equipe.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas, ou experiência equivalente.

  • Experiência com otimização de performance em WordPress.

  • Experiência com e-commerce WordPress (WooCommerce).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para ambientes WordPress.
  • Portfólio com exemplos de projetos WordPress desenvolvidos.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate - Simulation
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We combine engineering excellence with innovative digital solutions to solve real-world infrastructure challenges. From port and terminal digital twins to cloud-based inspection tools and automated 3D reconstruction, we deliver high-impact, data-driven insights to clients across the globe. We are actively looking for a Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate to join our Sao Paulo office. As part of the Flexterm Group, the Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate will help build robust pipelines that power simulation workflows, Kafka-driven data ingestion, Databricks-based data transformation, and cloud-based delivery of inspection and 3D data to client platforms. This is a hybrid position and will require some in-office presence in our office in Sao Paulo, BR.


About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbors and rivers, as well as an innovator in transportation. For the 4th year in a row, Moffatt & Nichol is Ranked #1 in Engineering News-Record for Marine & Port Facilities in the U.S. Additionally, our firm consistently ranks in the Top 100 Pure Designers in the US and the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.


Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, North America, Latin America, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in several primary practice areas – ports and harbors; coastal, environmental and water resources; urban waterfronts and marinas; transportation, bridges and rail; inspection and rehabilitation; and energy.


Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Azure Cloud Infrastructure

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable environments using Azure (AKS, VMs, Functions, Blob Storage, App Services, etc.)
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep to deploy and maintain consistent cloud environments

CI/CD and Automation

  • Create automated CI/CD pipelines for data processing, simulation, and 3D asset workflows
  • Enable cross-team automation for simulation engineers, inspection groups, and digital twin platform developers

Kafka & Databricks Pipelines

  • Set up and manage Kafka-based data ingestion from external platforms.
  • Integrate with Databricks for real-time and batch processing of simulation data, crack detection outputs, and inspection datasets

Simulation & Twin Integration

  • Deploy and orchestrate compute-heavy simulation jobs in the cloud
  • Integrate simulation results into real-time digital twin systems, enabling actionable insights on equipment performance and operational planning

3D Reconstruction & Inspection Workflows

  • Automate cloud-based 3D model reconstruction from inspection datasets (e.g., point clouds, drone imagery, crack detection outputs)
  • Package and deliver reconstructed 3D models and annotated inspection results via secure client portals or custom viewers

Client-Facing Delivery & Collaboration

  • Build secure sharing mechanisms for inspection reports, simulation results, and 3D models
  • Ensure reliable, auditable delivery pipelines that meet client compliance and usability needs

Security, Monitoring, and Resilience

  • Implement best practices in cloud security, encryption, and access control
  • Monitor systems using Azure Monitor, ELK, or Prometheus/Grafana to ensure availability, scalability, and performance


Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.


Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree (Software or Computer Engineering)
  • 4-8 years of experience
  • Strong experience with Azure services: AKS, Blob, Functions, App Gateway, and Networking
  • Proficient with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration at scale
  • Proficient with CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins
  • Hands-on with Kafka, including configuration, message flows, and monitoring
  • Experienced in Databricks: notebooks, pipelines, Delta Lake, and cluster management
  • Proficient in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for automation
  • Skilled in infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep


Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree
  • Familiarity with computer vision pipelines, crack detection, or point cloud processing
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Installers (MSI)
  • Experience creating digitally signed application installers and collaborating with QA for deployment testing
  • Understanding REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and real-time data delivery
  • Prior experience supporting engineering or infrastructure-focused teams
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171
  • Moffatt & Nichol uses E-Verify and employment is contingent upon the legal ability to obtain employment in the U.S. and to present the required documentation at hire

Por isso, buscamos pessoas que são inspiradoras, criam ambientes diversos, influenciam uma cultura colaborativa e, com isso, entregam valor. Nossa liderança é peça-chave para o nosso crescimento.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano mentorias com profissionais da Deloitte para que você possa ter uma visão complementar e direcionamentos sobre o seu crescimento. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Esperamos você neste time!

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information
The Team
Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

REDX is a SaaS company that builds prospecting software to help real estate agents and teams grow their business. Our platform offers high-quality lead data, productivity tools. We empower agents to build sustainable, scalable businesses by simplifying the listing process and providing the tools they need to succeed.

  • Backend: Node.js, Nest.js, MongoDB, Mongoose

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript

  • Experience building SDKs or mobile frameworks for reuse across teams

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams and mentoring junior engineers

What You'll Get

• Collaboration with a sharp team across product, design, and leadership

• A fast-moving environment where ideas are welcomed and results matter

• Competitive salary: $2200 - $4000 (USD) Depending on experience

We're not hiring just to fill a seat. We're hiring someone who wants to make a difference, contribute at a high level, and help us scale with quality and clarity. If that sounds like you, let's talk.

  • If your background doesn't yet align with these requirements, we truly appreciate your interest, but this may not be the right fit at this time. We encourage you to check back in the future as our team continues to grow.
  • This is a contract (PJ) position with potential for growth. The role is hybrid, with 1–2 days/week expected in our Curitiba office and the rest remote. You must be available to work during US hours (MST) to ensure team alignment.
